# Corvix Agency & Technical Hub - Austin, TX

> Corvix is a custom software development, AI agent engineering, and business setup agency based in Austin, Texas. We build production-grade web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, enterprise RAG pipelines, autonomous AI agents, and US LLC legal structures for tech startups, founders, and scaling businesses.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Web Development Agency Austin, TX**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Node.js, Laravel, Django. Sub-second performance, Core Web Vitals optimization, zero-shift animations (GSAP/Three.js), and headless CMS integration.
- **AI Agent & Custom LLM Engineering**: Enterprise RAG (Retriever-Augmented Generation) architectures, vector databases (PGVector, Pinecone, Weaviate), multi-model orchestration (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro), and autonomous agent workflows.
- **Mobile App Development**: React Native and Flutter cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android with biometrics, real-time WebSockets, offline sync, and App Store lifecycle management.
- **Texas Business Setup & Compliance**: LLC formation in Texas and Wyoming, IRS EIN registration, corporate governance docs (Operating Agreements, Bylaws), banking resolutions, and registered agent services for US and non-resident founders.
